nodes.label: Testcontainers Real Postgres Testing
nodes.rationale: Tests run against a real Postgres rather than mocks because the app's value is in its constraints (FKs, CHECKs, uniqueness) and a mocked DB would let broken constraints pass silently

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.rationale: Serves both the JSON API under /api and the built frontend SPA from the same process to avoid CORS and simplify deployment

nodes.norm_label: freight workflow: loading slip to receipt

nodes.label: Docker media_data volume
nodes.rationale: Persists uploaded firm logos across container rebuilds; without this volume, docker compose up --build wipes logo files while DB still references them via logo_url

nodes.label: Auth Stub Pattern
nodes.rationale: No auth yet, but get_current_actor() stub and can(action,resource) helper exist as seams so wiring Supabase auth later changes one function, not every screen

nodes.label: Computed Ledger Balances
nodes.rationale: Ledger balances are not stored but computed as accrued minus paid, giving a single source of truth for underlying numbers

nodes.label: Service Worker Unregistration Fix
nodes.rationale: GET /sw.js serves a one-time replacement that unregisters old service workers; required because the original offline PWA prototype registered a cache-first service worker that outlives the server's response and would continue serving stale content indefinitely after being replaced by the React frontend

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Records use is_deleted flag and are never hard-deleted because this is accounting data; FK RESTRICT prevents deletion of entities with ledger history

nodes.label: Session-Scoped Test Client Fixture
nodes.rationale: Test client fixture is session-scoped to avoid anyio blocking-portal thread interaction with asyncpg that caused alternating pass/fail on per-test scope
